## What's new

**Updating no longer depends on pnpm working**
- On some Windows setups the in-Discord update failed with "Vencord build failed ... Cannot find module ...\node\corepack ... MODULE_NOT_FOUND", even when rebuilding the previous version. The pnpm launcher was broken, not the build. The updater and `install.bat` now run Vencord's build with Node directly, and use pnpm only when that isn't possible.
- When rolling back also fails, the message now shows the rollback's own error.

## Update

If the in-Discord update to v1.18.1 failed for you, update once by hand: download `FriendsInVoice-v1.18.2.zip`, extract the whole archive, and run `install.bat` (macOS: `install.command`, Linux: `bash install.sh`). The version you have installed still builds with pnpm, so its update button keeps failing until this one manual update. Later updates work from the notification again.

BetterDiscord: replace the installed plugin with `FriendsInVoice.plugin.js` from this release and enable it. BetterDiscord was not affected.

## Verification

Updater tests (including the new build-command check) and 29 BetterDiscord tests pass; the platform workflow builds both plugins on macOS and Linux. The Windows fix was not run on the affected machine before release.
